title: 第19章 子虚乌有第20章 你是决定跟他们走还是跟我走
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: “陈观。”
洛璃赶紧从马车上跳了下来，拉着他的胳膊。
她也没想到这个家伙胆子这么大，一言不合就要动手。
你难道看不出这些人是一伙的？
她虽然没怎么开口说话，但能看出这些老镖人觉得自己的权威被陈观践踏，失了面子，才处处跟他作对，故意激怒他。
正在此时，陈观的眉头一皱，目光看向四周，“不好！”
“那群东西追上来了！”
“怎么这么快？”
他心中疑惑起来。
寄怨魔猿虽然恐怖，但他们的行军速度却并不是优势。
陈观突然意识到了什么，目光落在李飞雨旁边刘硕身上看了看。
“难道这两个家伙这是故意拖延时间？”
如果不是这两个家伙，那些东西绝对不会这么快追上，这两个家伙是明显有问题。
陈观沉默了几秒，随后勾起嘴角，收敛身上的杀气，放开他李飞。
在没搞清情况之前，他不想直接踩进这个陷阱。
众人见状当即松了一口气。
这小子实力已达通玄巅峰，真要动起手来，也就罗通几个才能抗衡，他们这个队伍必将会造成伤亡。
众人目光投向洛璃。
在他们看来，事情已经很明显了。
这小子看上了年轻貌美的小镖主，想故意表现自己的英勇之气，然后制造一些耸人听闻的恐怖言论来吓得她投怀送抱，想占一些便宜就直说。
这种事以前他们也没碰到过。
一些年轻的镖人，看重镖主的美色，都会使一些小伎俩。
而这镖主年纪又小，人又漂亮。
如能这位不谙世事的小丫头片子对他产生依赖，主动躲进他的怀里，这不就少奋斗几十年？
众人立刻露出一副鄙夷的眼神。
“行了，收起武器！”
罗通突然站出来，冲着众人挥了挥手。
虽然陈观完全不讲镖人规矩，这种强势让他极为不满。
但，他好歹在镖道上行走了50余年，结合自己的经验来判断，其实他认为陈观说的也不无道理。
之前那只魔猿的气息，他本就存疑，洛璃身上的气味也是真。
寄怨魔猿虽然他没听说过，但谁也不敢保证没有这种魔祟。
宁可信其有，不可信其无。
陈观看了看李飞，没有再搭理这些老油条。
随后将目光定在洛璃身上，心中暗道。
难道这个丫头身上带了什么财宝？
让那两个家伙眼红起来了？
可这个小丫头不就是三花镇的一个大户人家吗，能拿出什么值得人眼红的宝物？
他想一想没头绪，但他很相信自己的直觉，这两个人的异常举动，要么是有神经病，要么就是有问题。
没有太多时间耽搁，陈观甩开思绪，冲着洛璃冷声问道。
“你，走还是不走？”
洛璃看了看罗通等人，知道这些人压根不相信陈观，可她身上那洗不掉的烂桃子味，是实实在在的。
她到底是一个有主见之人。

;;
"Chen Guan."
Luo Li quickly jumped off the carriage and took his arm.
She didn't expect this guy to be so courageous and would take action if he disagreed.
Can't you see that these people are in the same group?
Although she didn't speak much, she could tell that these old bodyguards felt that their authority had been trampled on by Chen Guan and they had lost face, so they opposed him everywhere and deliberately angered him.
At this moment, Chen Guan frowned and looked around, "Not good!"
"Those things are catching up!"
"Why so fast?"
He became confused.
Although the Resentment Demonic Apes are terrifying, their marching speed is not an advantage.
Chen Guan suddenly realized something, and his eyes fell on Liu Shuo next to Li Feiyu.
"Are these two guys delaying time on purpose?"
If it weren't for these two guys, those things would never have caught up so quickly. There is obviously something wrong with these two guys.
Chen Guan was silent for a few seconds, then raised the corners of his mouth, restrained his murderous aura, and let go of Li Fei.
He didn't want to step directly into this trap before he understood the situation.
Everyone immediately breathed a sigh of relief when they saw this.
This kid's strength has reached the peak of Tongxuan. If he really wants to take action, only Luo Tong can compete with him. Their team will definitely cause casualties.
Everyone turned to Luo Li.
To them, it was obvious.
This guy fell in love with the young and beautiful escort master, and wanted to deliberately show his bravery, and then made some sensational and terrifying remarks to scare her into embracing her. If he wanted to take advantage, he would just say so.
They had never encountered this kind of thing before.
Some young escorts value the beauty of their escort masters and will use some tricks.
And this escort master is young and beautiful.
If this little girl who is inexperienced in the world can become dependent on him and take the initiative to hide in his arms, wouldn't it save decades of hard work?
Everyone immediately showed contempt.
"Okay, put away your weapons!"
Luo Tong suddenly stood up and waved to everyone.
Although Chen Guan didn't follow the rules of escorts at all, this kind of force made him extremely dissatisfied.
However, he has been walking on the escort road for more than 50 years, and based on his own experience, he actually thinks that what Chen Guan said is reasonable.
He was already suspicious of the smell of the demonic ape before, and the smell on Luo Li's body was also real.
Although he had never heard of the Demonic Ape, no one could guarantee that there was no such evil spirit.
It is better to believe that it exists than to believe that it does not exist.
Chen looked at Li Fei and ignored these old fools.
Then he fixed his gaze on Luo Li and thought to himself.
Could it be that this girl has some treasure with her?
Made those two guys jealous?
But isn't this little girl from a wealthy family in Sanhua Town? What treasures can she produce that are worthy of envy?
He had no idea after thinking about it, but he believed in his intuition. The abnormal behavior of these two people was either mental illness or there was something wrong.
Without much time to waste, Chen Guan shook off his thoughts and asked Luo Li coldly.
"Are you going or not?"
Luo Li looked at Luo Tong and others, knowing that these people didn't believe Chen Guan at all, but the rotten peach smell on her body that couldn't be washed away was real.
She is a person of her own opinion after all.
title_en: Chapter 19: Nothingness Chapter 20: Do you decide to go with them or with me?
